name: check_compliance
description: Final verification gate: run a compliance check against the generated Terraform files. IMPORTANT TIMING: call this tool ONLY after you have finished generating ALL Terraform files and are ready to complete the task. Do NOT call it before writing files — it inspects what you have already created. You MUST receive a passed=true result from this tool before calling task_complete. If the check fails, fix the violations and call this tool again.

scope.description: Description of what to check (e.g. 'all generated Terraform files in the workspace').

explanation.description: Brief explanation of why the compliance check is being triggered at this point.
